source_evidence: Player exact 'Yes, it would be an honor' accepts specifically offered carriage of confidential preliminary diplomatic invitation on next visit to Orsaven. Councillor accepts and directs preparation of sealed letter and messenger credentials subject to proper Crown authorization, not issued yet; limited role of messenger/facilitator, no treaty powers, new expenditure, compensation or guaranteed Ossent reception. Elara offers continuing political liaison in Caereth under existing delegation. Consultation continues to domestic emergency safeguards, with no enacted policy and V free to respond. No roll needed for voluntary acceptance. D316~14:20 Caereth palace defense consultation, V and Elara invited speakers with security councillor, advisers, Assembly representatives and general. V expressly accepts carrying confidential preliminary diplomatic invitation to appropriate Ossent authorities on his next planned Orsaven visit. Councillor thanks him and directs secretary to prepare a sealed Crown letter, authenticated messenger credentials for this limited delivery and recipient instructions through appropriate royal channels, for collection before departure; not yet drafted, issued or physically handed over, no date forced. Invitation proposes exploratory reciprocal frontier intelligence exchanges and possible joint inquiries without compromising either kingdom's Crown claims, sovereignty, fortress dispositions or existing commitments. No authority to negotiate or sign a treaty on Crown's behalf, guarantee acceptance, declare war, pledge troops/funds or publicly disclose Kestrel evidence. No fee or new payment agreed. Elara offers to maintain Caereth contact and follow consultation developments as standing Vaishnavi representative. General supports putting a limited preliminary invitation before proper Crown authority, not binding agreement or decision to deploy. Councillor moves to question of domestic emergency defense safeguards, seeks V's view on whether guildhall protocol can serve as local example; no new policy enacted. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 all pools full Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 inactive; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots; companions and coach/horses safe at Rethwyn residence, custody unchanged. Rest0/6 food21/feed28 purse2903gp4sp6cp, conditional240gp sale unpaid. Crown intelligence commission active remaining300+1300 contingent, liaison credentials V-held, Kestrel originals retained, Crown certified copies; Severin assent pending. Dice delegated until stop.
